system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Advantage on Perception checks underground or in stone structures. +1 AC while standing on natural stone or underground. Once/day, when your Smite hits, the stone heaves: the target makes a Fortitude save or is knocked prone.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Moradin in the World of Arneyan wiki.
